tool_tasks.task: What alerts are firing for support_agent?
How much did billing_agent cost us last month?
Is there an open pull request for the retry fix?
When is the next on-call handover meeting?
Did anyone post in the channel about the outage?
Roll back the release that broke the dashboard
Which customer complaints are still unresolved?
Change which model support_agent runs on
Is the registry up, or is it down right now?
Find where the retry limit is set in the source

memories.content: Priya owns support_agent.
The billing dashboard is checked daily.
support_agent status notes go to Priya weekly.
Status of search_agent: migrating.
The user wants summaries as bullet points.
The user prefers short answers without a preamble.
research_agent moves from claude-legacy to claude-sonnet before 31 October.
notes_agent's target model is claude-haiku.
On 27 August the registry was down for 42 minutes during a database failover.
The user was paged for the registry outage and asked for the timeline afterwards.
The user is on the platform on-call rota.
Tom is the Search team's contact for kb-search.
kb-search's cache TTL change caused research_agent's stale answers in June.
billing_agent's monthly spending cap is a finance matter; the user can't see it.
The user's team deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Rotate a leaked registry key first, investigate second.
The user drafts incident reports in the team's wiki template.
triage_agent hands tickets it can't close to support_agent.
The overview dashboard showed no agents during the registry outage.
The user asked for latency figures in milliseconds, not seconds.
The user's manager is Grace Okafor.
Dashboards should use their own registry keys, not an agent's.
Asked about the rate limit on 21 August; it is 60 requests per minute per key.
The user is writing a proposal to move billing_agent to the priority tier.

recall_tasks.task: Draft the weekly status note on support_agent

How should I format my reply to this user?

Which days does the team ship changes?
What is the registry rate limit per key?
